summary: This note is a wiki-style entry on Bobby Brown, a uniformed officer of the Western District as depicted in The Wire. It covers his early role at crime scenes, his later assignment to watch a home for Detective Jimmy McNulty, and his reassignment under Major Colvin's Hamsterdam initiative in season 3.
one_line: Bobby Brown is a Western District uniformed officer in The Wire whose roles include crime scenes, surveillance, and Hamsterdam-era complaint investigations.
key_facts: Bobby Brown is a Western District uniformed officer.
Bobby Brown was the first officer on scene at the shooting of William Gant.
Bobby Brown was also at the Brandon Wright crime scene.
Detective Jimmy McNulty later enlisted Bobby Brown to help watch the home of Wallace.
In season 3, Major Colvin institutes the Hamsterdam initiative.
Under the Hamsterdam initiative, Bobby Brown is one of the officers freed up to investigate complaints rather than perform radio car patrols.
Bobby Brown solves a church burglary case in season 3.
